mentions.name: ChronoNotes
mentions.description: A simple note-taking tool that manages "trackers" (tagged items such as [BUG-N]) and has built-in filtering to "trace" updates, so progress can be followed without jumping around a single text file or using grep. It includes a backend and is being dogfooded by its creator.
mentions.problem: A single text file was all the author needed for notes, but it made it difficult to keep track of a variety of things; using the file as a manual tag-based project tracker meant jumping around the file or using grep to follow progress.
mentions.audience: Fellow note takers; the author also keeps it for personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I condensed the idea to just that - a very simple tool which manages "trackers", and has a simple filtering built in to "trace" the updates. I've been using it, since I've added the BE, and dogfooding it a bunch. Would love for fellow note takers to take a look. It's not perfect, but I'm keeping it around for myself :)
